work: Allgäu-Coaster is a separately ticketed Wiegand alpine coaster beside the Söllereckbahn lower station in Kornau, not an amusement park ride. Five official editor searches for Söllereck, Allgäu Coaster and Söllereck-Rodel found no Park or StandaloneAttraction. Created a standalone entity with eight authored descriptions, the operator-confirmed track length, speed and two-seat sleds, date-scoped official autumn hours and six date-scoped official fares, two verified child access conditions, and one exact visually inspected Commons photo. The licensed photo was taken 3 June 2012 and is captioned as a historic view. Eight localized site pages and photo binary verified HTTP 200 before Facebook publication. Summer 2026 season ends 8 November; operator has not fixed winter 2026/27 start date.
qualification: Rail coaster with its own single-ride and multi-ride fares at a ski/mountain resort, separately visitable from the cable car.
